description: Real rows from any dataset with no key: registration status, entities, opportunities, awards, exclusions, recompetes, NAICS, labor rates or expiring registrations, up to 5 rows a call, same fields as the API. Use it to try the data before your user signs up (10,000 free credits a month, 120 requests a minute, no card).
